steps.name: 1,2-dichloro-1,2-dihydro-3H-1?3-benzo[d][1,2]iodazol-3-one S-2
steps.procedure:
Procedure I: {R:t-BuOCl} (4.88 g, 45 mmol, 1.5 equiv.) was added to a solution of {R:2-
iodobenzamide S-1} (7.41 g, 30 mmol, 1.0 equiv.) in 50 mL {S:CH2Cl2}. The reaction
mixture was stirred at {T:room temperature} for {H:12 h} in dark under air. When the reaction
was complete, the precipitate was filtered and washed with petroleum ether (2 ? 30 mL)
and CH2Cl2 (2 ? 10 mL) to give {P:1,2-dichloro-1,2-dihydro-3H-1?3-
benzo[d][1,2]iodazol-3-one S-2} (9.1 g) in {Y:94%} yield as a yellow solid. 1H NMR (400
MHz, CDCl3) ? 8.31 (d, J = 8.0 Hz, 1H), 8.25 (dd, J = 7.5, 1.7 Hz, 1H), 7.88 (ddd, J =
8.7, 7.4, 1.7 Hz, 1H), 7.80   7.68 (m, 1H); 13C NMR (101 MHz, CDCl3) ? 164.8, 135.8,
132.0, 131.7, 129.8, 127.2, 116.2

steps.name: CFBI
steps.procedure:
Procedure II: Under an argon atmosphere, S-2 (2 g, 6.4 mmol, 1.0 equiv.) was placed
in a 100 mL round-bottom flask. Anhydrous {S:CH2Cl2} (40 mL) was added, followed by
{R:AgF2} (2.3 g, 16 mmol, 2.5 equiv.). The reaction mixture was stirred at {T:room temperature}
and monitored by 1H NMR spectroscopy. Additional AgF2 was added in portions until
NMR analysis indicated complete consumption of S-2. The mixture was filtered
through a pad of dry Celite, and the filtrate was concentrated under reduced pressure to
afford {P:CFBI} as a pale yellow solid in {Y:68%} yield. 1H NMR (400 MHz, CDCl3) ? 8.26
(dt, J = 7.6, 1.3 Hz, 1H), 8.08   7.94 (m, 1H), 7.90 (td, J = 7.8, 1.6 Hz, 1H), 7.70 (td, J
= 7.5, 1.1 Hz, 1H); 13C NMR (101 MHz, CDCl3) ?165.1, 135.6, 131.6, 131.4, 129.5,
128.7 (d, J = 7.2 Hz), 117.9 (d, J = 9.3 Hz); 19F NMR (376 MHz, CDCl3) ? -126.93.
HR-MS (ESI): m/z Calcd. for C7H4ClFINO (M+H+): 299.9083, Found: 299.9081.
